Container.Name: voidcrude
Container.Overview: VOIDCRUDE - a retro pixel-art asteroid drilling tycoon inspired by Turmoil. Scan for glowing voidcrude, steer drill pipes, haul crude to refineries and outmaneuver rival corporations. Pick a tycoon, unlock tech, and earn Legacy across runs. Played in your browser - progress is saved in each browser's local storage, so no appdata is needed.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port on your Unraid server used to open the game in a browser (http://SERVER-IP:PORT). Pick any free port.

Config.Name: Container Port
Config.Description: Port the web server listens on inside the container. Leave at 80 for normal Bridge networking. Only change it when using Host or a custom (br0) network, where this becomes the port you browse to.
